### [Tape With Wisdom][109]

Tape With Wisdom refers to the skill level of our medical professionals, but as Dr. Kase notes,
“There is wisdom in Kinesio Tape itself.” Our education program is created to share insights into
the body’s powerful natural healing and the beneficial effect “wise” taping can have to unleash it
and achieve notable results for pain relief, physiological balance and overall patient advocacy.

### [Quality][111]

Kinesio Taping® Education is based on over 40 years of evidence based research and is one of the key
elements of the Kinesio Taping Method. Kinesio Tape made with premium materials and goes through a
12 step quality check.

We created the industry back in 1979. We aim to create the best education and taping products. We
take our work very seriously, love doing what we do and we care. We strive everyday to create things
that will help people live a better quality of life.

## FAQs

#### What does Kinesio® Taping and Kinesio® Tape do?

The Kinesio® Taping Method is applied on the body to reduce pain and inflammation for various
medical conditions. Kinesio^{®} Tex Tape is a elastic therapeutic tape made specifically for the
Kinesio Taping Method to microscopically lift the skin and motivate the body to start healing
naturally. It is non- restrictive and allows for full range of motion.

#### Isn't all tape Kinesio tape?

No! Not all tape is created equal. Kinesio^{®} is a name brand, just like Band-Aid^{®}, Dr.
Scholl’s^{®}, Nike^{®} and Under Armour^{®}.

#### Isn't Kinesio, short for Kinesiology?

No. Kinesio^{®} is the name of Kinesio Holding Corporation, a company that that specializes in
developing, researching and evolving Kinesio^{®} Tape products and the Kinesio Taping^{®} Method as
created by the company’s founder, Dr. Kenzo Kase^{®}, in 1979.

#### How many CEU’s apply for the courses?

CEUs awarded for seminars vary by state and profession. They can range from 1 to 20 hours. For
information for CEUs you would qualify for, please contact our Seminar Department at 1-888-320-8273
or via email at [seminar@kinesiotaping.com][127]

## Learn More About Kinesio

Kinesio is a group of three organizations dedicated to the Kinesio Taping^{®} Method:
Kinesio University^{®}, Kinesio Taping Association International (KTAI) and Kinesio^{®} Holding
Corporation (KHC).
Each focuses on different areas of our mission.

## FAQs

#### What does Kinesio® Taping and Kinesio® Tape do?

The Kinesio® Taping Method is applied on the body to reduce pain and inflammation for various
medical conditions. Kinesio^{®} Tex Tape is a elastic therapeutic tape made specifically for the
Kinesio Taping Method to microscopically lift the skin and motivate the body to start healing
naturally. It is non- restrictive and allows for full range of motion.

#### Isn't all tape Kinesio tape?

No! Not all tape is created equal. Kinesio^{®} is a name brand, just like Band-Aid^{®}, Dr.
Scholl’s^{®}, Nike^{®} and Under Armour^{®}.

#### Isn't Kinesio, short for Kinesiology?

No. Kinesio^{®} is the name of Kinesio Holding Corporation, a company that that specializes in
developing, researching and evolving Kinesio^{®} Tape products and the Kinesio Taping^{®} Method as
created by the company’s founder, Dr. Kenzo Kase^{®}, in 1979.

#### How many CEU’s apply for the courses?

CEUs awarded for seminars vary by state and profession. They can range from 1 to 20 hours. For
information for CEUs you would qualify for, please contact our Seminar Department at 1-888-320-8273
or via email at [seminar@kinesiotaping.com][127]

## Learn More About Kinesio

Kinesio is a group of three organizations dedicated to the Kinesio Taping^{®} Method:
Kinesio University^{®}, Kinesio Taping Association International (KTAI) and Kinesio^{®} Holding
Corporation (KHC).
Each focuses on different areas of our mission.

# Actimove. Feel good. Move better.

Actimove provides quality orthopedic braces and supports for muscles and joints. If you’re
recovering from an injury or managing a chronic condition, trust Actimove products to help manage
pain and increase mobility.

## Where does it hurt?

Actimove braces and supports are targeted for different body parts, covering a variety of injuries
and conditions.

### Knee braces and supports

Discover specially tailored braces and supports to help manage knee pain.

[ Knee support products ][48]

### Wrist, elbow and thumb braces and supports

Browse a range of braces and supports for sore wrists, elbows and thumbs.

[ Wrist, elbow and thumb support products ][49]

### Ankle braces and supports

Find a suitable product to support sprained ankles and other ankle conditions.

[ Ankle support products ][50]

Actimove offers a broad portfolio of medically engineered braces and supports. Our products come in
different ranges tailored for individual needs, giving you the confidence to manage pain, feel good
and move better.

[ Show all product categories ][51]

ACTIMOVE. FEEL GOOD. MOVE BETTER.

## Why Actimove

All of life’s precious moments are supported by movement. When life slows you down, turn to Actimove
for support. Driven by continual innovation, we craft high quality medical braces and supports for
every step of your journey.

[ About us ][52]

## Drawing on 80 years’ experience in non-invasive orthopedics, Actimove prides itself on providing
## medical devices that are reliable and thoroughly tested

-ACTIMOVE. FEEL GOOD. MOVE BETTER.

## Buy Actimove

Whether online or in store, learn where you can shop Actimove braces and supports.

[ Where to buy ][53]
